title: Seat Ranges, Licence Rates and Reassignment Terms of the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Every tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes publishes the range of traveller seats it may be contracted for, the seats its subscription already carries, the monthly licence for each further seat, the charge to move a seat between named travellers and the calendar days a seat must be held before it may be moved.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Smallest number of seats the programme may be contracted for | 1 | 5 | 20 | 75 | 250 | 750 |
| Seats carried by the subscription before licences are charged | 3 | 10 | 35 | 120 | 400 | 1200 |
| Largest number of seats the tier accepts | 9 | 49 | 199 | 749 | 2499 | 25000 |
| Monthly licence for each seat beyond those included | 9.00 USD | 7.50 USD | 6.00 USD | 4.50 USD | 3.25 USD | 2.00 USD |
| Charge to move a seat to another named traveller | 25.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 10.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Calendar days a seat must be held before it may be moved | 90 | 60 | 30 | 14 | 7 | 0 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The seat range of a tier is read inclusively at both ends: the Business Team Programme is contracted for no fewer than 5 seats and no more than 49, and the Business Global Programme for no fewer than 750 and no more than 25000.
2. The seats carried by the subscription always exceed the tier's minimum: 3 against 1 on the Business Starter Programme, 10 against 5 on the Business Team Programme, 35 against 20 on the Business Pro Programme, 120 against 75, 400 against 250 and 1200 against 750.
3. The monthly seat licence falls as the tier rises, from 9.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme through 7.50 USD, 6.00 USD, 4.50 USD and 3.25 USD to 2.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
4. Moving a seat is charged at 25.00 USD on the Business Starter Programme, 15.00 USD on the Business Team Programme and 10.00 USD on the Business Pro Programme. No charge is published for the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme or the Business Global Programme, whose figures stand at 0.00 USD.
5. The holding period before a seat may be moved shortens from 90 calendar days on the Business Starter Programme through 60, 30, 14 and 7 to 0 calendar days on the Business Global Programme.
